processes.name: Scheduling web app
processes.description: A web app used by store managers to build weekly rotas and by colleagues to view assigned shifts.

processes.name: Scheduling service
processes.description: A service that reads and writes rotas in the rota database and writes a weekly payroll export to the file share.
processes.source_excerpt: The scheduling service is what actually reads and writes the rotas, which live in a rota database.

processes.name: Payroll system
processes.description: A payroll system run by another team that collects the export from the file share.
processes.source_excerpt: The payroll system, which is run by another team, collects the export from the file share.
